fee_notes: For designated territory with population 75,000-250,000; fully earned upon payment; no refunds under any circumstances
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for a Designated Territory with a population of approximately 75,000 to 250,000 persons (as determined by the latest US Census or other recognized Data Collection agency) is $45,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is due when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is fully earned upon payment, and there are no refunds under any circumstances.
